people.name: Lot
people.line: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

people.name: Sodom
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God for its sins

translations.web: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.
translations.bsb: But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
translations.kjv: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
